verdict.rationale: Twilio Video documents server-side recording: track recordings and recording compositions are priced products, recordings can be encrypted, and status-callback webhooks fire for Recording and Composition resources. Nothing in the evidence shows recordings or compositions being delivered to a customer-owned storage bucket, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: documented delivery of recording files to a customer's own bucket (e.g. external S3 storage), a docs walkthrough of starting and stopping server-side recording, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can record a session server-side and receive the files in my own storage bucket

citations.quote: Track recordings cost $0.004 per participant minute and recording compositions (customized video layouts created from individual recordings) cost $0.01 per composed minute.
Record video for future reference and securely store media by generating encrypted recordings
Status Callbacks allow you to receive events related to the REST resources managed by Twilio: Rooms, Recordings, and Compositions.
